WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category AS cur_category,
  CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END AS asis_category,
  SUM(n.net_sales) net_sales, COUNT(*) n
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
  AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (

    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
rpt AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales rs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<>999)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(m.ns) mine, SUM(r.rs) rpt, SUM(m.ns)-SUM(r.rs) diff
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.business_date=d.calendar_date
FULL JOIN rpt r ON r.business_date=m.business_date AND r.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_cat AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year,
           CASE WHEN cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END AS category,
           SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
       'FY2025/26' AS this_year_fiscal_year, ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales,
       'FY2024/25' AS prior_year_fiscal_year, ly.net_sales AS prior_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_cat ty JOIN by_cat ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
ORDER BY ty.category
